title: Autobahn
description:
Our engine only fires with the right password. We built it tough: pop it open in a disassembler and the important part is pure noise. It only makes sense once the engine is running.

Usage: ./nitro <password>

Hint: objdump shows you the code at rest. This engine rewrites itself the moment it starts. The key that unlocks the flag is not a constant you can read off — the engine grinds it out of its own running code. Guessing the keystream will not work; you have to let the rewrite happen first or reproduce it exactly.
